article.story: KENT, Ohio -- — D'Shawntae Jones ran for 121 yards and two touchdowns, and Miami (Ohio) beat Kent State 20-3 on Tuesday night. It was Miami's (7-4, 5-2 Mid-American Conference) fifth win in its last six contests. Kent State (3-8, 2-5) has lost five of its last six. Jones' 1-yard touchdown run on the game-starting drive that went seven plays over 67 yards made it 7-0. A little past the midway point of the first quarter, Tommy Newcomb kicked a 39-yard field goal for the Golden Flashes' only points. With 22 seconds before the first ended, Jones again crashed in from the 1 for a 13-3 lead after the missed point-after. Scoring for both teams ended with 9:46 left before the end of the third when quarterback Drew Bellisari had a 23-yard scoring run to end a seven-play, 74-yard drive. Brandon Jones caught four passes for 46 yards for Kent State. The Redhawks outgained Kent State 425 to 170 in total yards. Jones averaged 4.2 yards in 29 carries for Miami.
